sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the set. This one pops the moment your 54th trophy lands, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger missions and activities, then the collectible and money clean-up — and it will come on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and unmissable — just play through the intro until the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through all of Chapter 1's missions and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Before you finish the chapter, meditate at the balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the only missable trophy in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Finish every mission in the chapter and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish every mission in the chapter and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish every mission in the chapter and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. Finish it and the trophy pops as the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Play through the story until it appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Finish this heist mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Finish it when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish it when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Finish this airport mission when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish it when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: finish the story, every stranger strand, every activity, every collectible and every challenge. The in-game stats page tracks your percentage — use this checklist to find what is left. PowerPyx's 100% checklist is the best place to check off the requirements one by one.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time in vehicles. Chain jumps and near-misses in traffic and the count climbs fast — each stunt registers as you pull it off.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You only need to take part, not win — try fishing, a race, the shooting range, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race and the rest, one of each.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range and gold every one of its 42 challenges. Learn each challenge's target pattern first, then go for a clean, fast run — gold needs both speed and accuracy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course on a practice run, then race to win — the drone handles differently from a car, so take the corners wide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each race is a different one. Work through the race list and tick them off as you win them.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal and out-fish him — use the right bait for the spot and keep your line steady when a fish bites.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and play any of its games through to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger-mission strand — the trophy pops on his last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger-mission strand — the trophy pops on his last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger-mission strand — the trophy pops on his last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 stranger strands in the game, so finish any 8 of them — the named strangers (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest) each have their own strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger-mission strand — the trophy pops on his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger-mission strand — the trophy pops on his last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation spot is on a balcony in Chapter 1 — meditate there during Chapter 1, before the chapter ends, or you cannot get it later. Keep a Chapter 1 save as a backup. The other 17 spots can be visited any time after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret asks you to hunt one specific unique animal — track it to its habitat and take the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find collectible cards scattered around Leonida and finish any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots across Leonida — each new location counts once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Any 50 of the game's challenges count — stunts, races, shooting and more all feed this total, so it builds up naturally as you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get the cops to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row — keep your wanted level up between robberies, so do not wait around or lose the cops in between.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or find 100 different vehicles across Leonida — each new vehicle you get into counts toward the total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus in a busy fight and drop 5 enemies before it ends — pick a spot where enemies group up so you can chain the kills.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get to a plane on the tarmac and take off without clearance — steal one and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks. Get into a Rhino yourself or take them on — either way, the tanks are the point of this one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Hit the store quietly — stay out of sight, avoid the cameras and the guards, grab the goods and get out clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan your exit before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road and get away with the cash.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the map — the in-game map tracks which areas you have been to, so check it for the gaps and drive out to them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida — rob one illegal operation from each of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car out through a showroom's front — straight through the glass, the classic GTA way.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Play a game there and see it through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build your partnership's appeal to the top — keep doing things together and this partnership milestone pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Keep making choices in the game — PSN tracks a count up to 500, and the trophy pops as that count climbs.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No method was confirmed at launch for this trophy. The guides list it as unconfirmed — check PowerPyx's trophy guide for updates as players pin the method down, rather than guessing.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while you explore — something odd is out there, and seeing it is the whole trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No method was confirmed at launch for this trophy. The guides list it as unconfirmed — check PowerPyx's trophy guide for updates as players pin the method down, rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Keep moving marked bills through your contacts until you have laundered $250,000 in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, cars and more all count — your spending across every shop in Leonida adds up to the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida — save up, then buy them one by one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 different vehicles in the app — each new registration counts.
